getObjectsV1.description: DISCOVERY: Start unknown-asset searches here. MCP defaults to root=true and returns at most 50 compact objects; follow pagination.nextOffset with the same filters if needed. Explicitly set root=false only when the user requests full-model enumeration. Then navigate from returned elementIds with queryRelatedObjectsV1. Never guess typeElementId values such as "plc"; filter only with an exact known type ID.

queryRelatedObjectsV1.description: NAVIGATION: Follow relationships from one or a few real elementIds returned by discovery. MCP returns at most 50 related objects per source; use body.offset with the same elementIds to continue. Follow only the relevant branch to connected equipment, components, properties, Memory, or DataBlocks. Leave relationshipType unset unless its exact value is known. Not a full-model search.

queryLastKnownValuesV1.description: READ CURRENT VALUES only after discovering the target property's exact elementId. Batch only a few relevant property IDs and use maxDepth=1. Do not read container objects that have no value. To read many properties under one known container without generating a long ID array, use readContainerValues. History is a separate tool.

readContainerValues.description: READ MANY CURRENT VALUES under one discovered container in one short tool call. Pass the exact containerId from discovery/navigation; the server finds descendant properties and reads at most 50 per page (default 50). Continue with offset when nextOffset is returned. Do not use on a plant root or broad asset unless the user requests all its values. Returns each property's name, ID, value, quality, and timestamp; it does not read container values or history.

queryHistoricalValuesV1.description: READ HISTORY only when the user explicitly asks for a trend or past values. Supply known elementIds and a narrow startTime/endTime interval; use maxDepth=1 unless component history is specifically needed. MCP returns 100 samples per page; use body.offset to continue. For current state use queryLastKnownValuesV1.

listObjectsByIdV1.description: Fetch specific objects by exact elementIds already returned by discovery or navigation. Keep the ID list narrow. Do not use this to discover assets or enumerate the model; start unknown searches with getObjectsV1(root=true).

getInfoV1.description: Return server version and capabilities. Use only for a server-information question regarding i3X, not to discover industrial assets or inspect model contents.

getNamespacesV1.description: ADVANCED: List OPC UA namespaces only when the user asks about namespaces or when a specific mapping issue must be diagnosed. Do not start asset discovery here; use getObjectsV1(root=true). Namespace output may be lengthy.

getObjectTypesV1.description: ADVANCED SCHEMA LOOKUP: Use only for explicit type/schema questions, not asset discovery. MCP returns compact type summaries in pages of 50; use pagination.nextOffset to continue and queryObjectTypesV1 for a selected schema. Find assets first with getObjectsV1(root=true), then navigate.

queryObjectTypesV1.description: Look up type schemas for exact elementIds when type details are required. Prefer a narrow lookup over getObjectTypesV1, which lists all types. Not for asset discovery or reading values.

getRelationshipTypesV1.description: ADVANCED: Use only when the user asks for relationship vocabulary or a relationship name is needed but unavailable from navigation results. MCP returns compact entries in pages of 50; continue with pagination.nextOffset. Do not call before asset discovery.

queryRelationshipTypesV1.description: Look up relationship types for exact elementIds when relationship schema details are explicitly needed. Prefer this narrow lookup over getRelationshipTypesV1. Not a substitute for navigating actual relationships with queryRelatedObjectsV1.

createSubscriptionV1.description: Create a value-monitoring subscription only when the user asks for ongoing monitoring. First discover the relevant property elementIds; subscribe only to those signals.

registerMonitoredItemsV1.description: Add known property elementIds to an existing subscription when ongoing monitoring is requested. Do not register container objects or guess IDs.

removeMonitoredItemsV1.description: Remove specified monitored items from a subscription when requested. Use exact item IDs; do not use for reading values.

syncSubscriptionV1.description: Fetch and acknowledge pending subscription updates when the user asks to sync or retrieve updates. Not for one-time current-value reads; use queryLastKnownValuesV1 for those.

deleteSubscriptionsV1.description: Delete specified subscriptions only when the user explicitly asks to stop/remove them. Confirm the target subscription IDs from context; this changes monitoring state.

listSubscriptionsV1.description: List or inspect subscriptions when the user asks about monitoring configuration or status. This does not discover industrial assets or read model values.

industrial_discovery_workflow.description: Find assets and answers using the smallest safe discovery path
industrial_discovery_workflow.template:
Answer this industrial-model question: {{question}}

Workflow:
1. For an unknown asset, call getObjectsV1 with root=true. Never call getObjectsV1({}) or enumerate the full model.
2. Identify the matching top-level asset from its name and returned details. Do not guess typeElementId or elementIds.
3. Navigate only the relevant branch with queryRelatedObjectsV1 using returned elementIds. Repeat only when the target is deeper.
4. For one or a few current values, find the named property and call queryLastKnownValuesV1 with exact elementIds and maxDepth=1. For many values under one known container, call readContainerValues with its exact containerId; do not generate a long ID array. Do not read container values.
5. Use queryHistoricalValuesV1 only when history/trend is explicitly requested, with a narrow time interval.
6. Avoid namespace/type catalogs unless the question explicitly concerns schemas or mapping.

Return the answer and identify missing data rather than broadening to a full-model scan.

inspect_asset.description: Inspect one named asset and report its relevant structure or requested properties
inspect_asset.template:
Inspect asset {{asset_name}} for this request: {{question}}

Start with getObjectsV1(root=true) only if the asset elementId is not already known. Match the returned asset by name; never guess IDs or typeElementId values. Navigate from that asset with queryRelatedObjectsV1 and follow only the branch needed to answer. For a current value, locate the named property first, then call queryLastKnownValuesV1 on only its exact elementId with maxDepth=1. Do not read container values or history unless explicitly requested. Avoid global object/type/namespace listings. Return concise findings with source object/property names.

inspect_signal.description: Locate one named signal and return its current value or requested details
inspect_signal.template:
Find signal {{signal_name}} under asset {{asset_name}}.

If the asset ID is unknown, call getObjectsV1(root=true), match the asset by name, then navigate relevant relationships with queryRelatedObjectsV1. Continue from returned IDs until the named property is found. Do not guess IDs, use guessed typeElementId filters, or list the whole model. Read only the matching property's current value with queryLastKnownValuesV1(elementIds=[exact property ID], maxDepth=1). Do not query history unless requested. Report value, quality, timestamp, and the matched property path; if no match exists, say so.

inspect_plc.description: Find a connected PLC and inspect requested PLC data such as OrderNumber, firmware, DataBlocks, or Memory variables
inspect_plc.template:
For asset {{asset_name}}, answer: {{question}}

If needed, discover top-level assets with getObjectsV1(root=true); identify the named asset from returned data. Use queryRelatedObjectsV1 with actual returned elementIds to find the connected PLC/controller, then navigate only the PLC branch. Never guess IDs or typeElementId values such as "plc". For OrderNumber or firmware version, locate the exact property and read it with queryLastKnownValuesV1(maxDepth=1). For DataBlock counts or Memory variables, navigate to the relevant collection/container and count/list the returned entries; do not read container values. If asked for many current values under one container, use readContainerValues with the exact containerId instead of assembling property IDs. Avoid full-model scans and type/namespace catalogs. State what was found and distinguish absent data from an unsuccessful lookup.

machine_health_snapshot.description: Summarize current machine condition using relevant signals and only requested history
machine_health_snapshot.template:
Assess machine {{asset_id}}. Lookback: {{lookback_minutes}} minutes.

If asset_id is a name rather than an elementId, discover roots with getObjectsV1(root=true) and match it. Navigate only relevant components/signals with queryRelatedObjectsV1. Read current values only for relevant properties using queryLastKnownValuesV1(maxDepth=1). Query historical values only for those signals and only within the stated lookback if trend evidence is needed. Do not enumerate the model or inspect type/namespace catalogs. Summarize evidence, uncertainty, severity, and safe checks; do not infer unsupported failure causes.

alarm_triage.description: Triage an alarm using narrow asset navigation and relevant signal evidence
alarm_triage.template:
Triage alarm {{alarm_text}} for asset {{asset_id}}. Relevant window: {{time_window}}.

If the asset ID is unknown, call getObjectsV1(root=true) and match by name. Navigate only related alarm/process signals using queryRelatedObjectsV1. Read current values for relevant properties with queryLastKnownValuesV1(maxDepth=1); use queryHistoricalValuesV1 only for those known signal IDs and the specified window. Do not scan all objects or types. Separate observed facts from hypotheses and provide safe, non-invasive operator checks; do not recommend bypassing safeguards.

predictive_maintenance_check.description: Assess degradation using selected signals and bounded history
predictive_maintenance_check.template:
Assess degradation risk for asset {{asset_id}} over {{lookback_days}} days.

Resolve an unknown asset using getObjectsV1(root=true), then queryRelatedObjectsV1 only for relevant condition signals. Read current values for selected properties with queryLastKnownValuesV1(maxDepth=1). Use queryHistoricalValuesV1 for only those signal IDs and the stated period. Do not enumerate the full model. State evidence and uncertainty, recommend inspections, and suggest subscriptions only if ongoing monitoring is requested.

process_drift_analysis.description: Analyze a named KPI for drift using only relevant assets and signals
process_drift_analysis.template:
Analyze {{kpi_name}} for {{line_or_cell}} over {{lookback_hours}} hours.

If the line/cell is not identified by elementId, discover roots with getObjectsV1(root=true), then navigate the matching asset using queryRelatedObjectsV1. Find only the KPI and directly relevant signals. Query history for those known IDs and the requested time window; read current values only if needed. Do not list the whole model or object types. Report observed drift, evidence, and plausible causes separately; do not recommend unverified control-limit changes.

downtime_root_cause.description: Reconstruct a downtime event from selected signals in the stated interval
downtime_root_cause.template:
Analyze downtime for {{asset_id}} from {{downtime_start}} to {{downtime_end}}.

Resolve the asset with getObjectsV1(root=true) only if its ID is unknown, then navigate only relevant components and signals with queryRelatedObjectsV1. Query historical values for selected signal IDs over the event interval; use maxDepth=1 unless component history is necessary. Read current values only for post-event status. Avoid full-model scans. Distinguish confirmed telemetry from inferred causes and summarize timeline, containment, and follow-up.

energy_intensity_review.description: Review energy patterns for a named asset or line using selected measurements
energy_intensity_review.template:
Review energy use for {{asset_or_line}} over {{lookback_days}} days. Production context: {{production_context}}.

If needed, discover the asset with getObjectsV1(root=true), then navigate only relevant energy and production signals using queryRelatedObjectsV1. Query history only for those property IDs and the stated period; use current values only if needed for operating state. Do not enumerate the full model or type catalog. Separate measured patterns from estimates and list concise, evidence-based opportunities.

opcua_data_quality_audit.description: Check telemetry quality for selected signals without scanning the full model
opcua_data_quality_audit.template:
Audit data quality for asset {{asset_id}} over {{lookback_hours}} hours.

Resolve an unknown asset with getObjectsV1(root=true), then use queryRelatedObjectsV1 to select only relevant properties. Use queryLastKnownValuesV1 for freshness and queryHistoricalValuesV1 for continuity only on those IDs and within the stated period. Do not call getObjectsV1 without root=true, and do not inspect namespaces unless a mapping issue is explicitly suspected. Report observed missingness, staleness, timestamp/value anomalies, and limits of the evidence.

shift_handover_summary.description: Create a concise handover from relevant current state and the stated shift interval
shift_handover_summary.template:
Prepare a handover for {{area}} covering {{shift_window}}.

If the area is not identified, discover roots with getObjectsV1(root=true), then navigate only relevant assets/signals using queryRelatedObjectsV1. Read current values for selected properties with queryLastKnownValuesV1(maxDepth=1). Use history only for relevant signals in the shift window. Inspect subscriptions only if pending monitored updates are specifically relevant. Avoid full-model enumeration. Summarize events, unresolved issues, evidence, and next-shift checks.

i3x_context_mapping_assistant.description: Review existing i3X context for a mapping task; use schema catalogs only when requested
i3x_context_mapping_assistant.template:
Review {{asset_id_or_namespace}} for this mapping goal: {{mapping_goal}}.

For an asset, start with getObjectsV1(root=true) if needed and navigate the relevant branch with queryRelatedObjectsV1. Do not enumerate all objects. Use getNamespacesV1 only when namespace alignment is part of the task. Use getObjectTypesV1 or getRelationshipTypesV1 only when the mapping goal requires vocabulary/schema details; prefer targeted query tools when exact IDs are known. Report only relevant existing objects, links, gaps, and a minimal mapping checklist.
